decision_conditions: The extension to the outbuilding by virtue of the excessive cumulative footprint and inappropriate details of design, causes harm to the character and appearance of the application property and to the character and appearance of the surrounding area. The proposal thereby fails to comply with Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (November 2012) and Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12 and DMHD 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (January 2020).

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
description: Erection of extension to outbuilding, and conversion of part of the building into a granny annex (Part retrospective planning application)
